description: UK company officers and directors, live from Companies House, the official UK company registry: directors and secretaries with role, appointment date, nationality, occupation, country of residence and birth year only, never the month of birth or a correspondence address (GDPR minimisation). Includes active/resigned counts. Open Government Licence v3.0. Paid via x402 ($0.01 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

company_number.description: Companies House company number, 8 characters incl. leading zeros, e.g. 00102498 or SC123456

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_uk_company_officers

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.
